This form can be printed or saved with the information fields filled in or as a blank copy of the form. It cannot be submitted electronically.
THIS FORM IS REQUIRED FOR:
All deeds (warranty deed, quit claim deed, grantor’s deed, sheriff’s deed, trustee’s deed, mineral deed, and similar instruments), a contract for deed, a memorandum of a contract for deed, addenda to contract for deed, and notice of contract for deed.
THIS FORM IS NOT REQUIRED FOR:
Divorce Decree, Probate Decree, Easement, Transfer on Death Deed, or instruments to the State of South Dakota conveying highway right-of-way (SDCL 7-9-7.3)
The buyer/grantee must use a mailing address. It will be used for tax notices.
Thank you, South Dakota Property Tax Division
